metadata.description: Small Claude Code mods that save you money, typing and surprises: usage limits at a glance, auto-compact for idle chats, one-click quick replies, and /check for follow-ups.

plugins.name: limits
plugins.description: Never get surprised by a rate limit again. An always-on band above the prompt shows your 5-hour and weekly Claude usage with live bars, reset countdowns and context-window fill. It turns red when your pace will run out before the reset, and warns you at 75%, 90% and 100%.

plugins.name: idle-compact
plugins.description: Come back to big chats for less. When a large chat (150k+ tokens) has been idle for 25 minutes, it is compacted while the prompt cache is still warm, so picking it up later is cheap. The summary keeps your last request, open tasks, decisions, file paths, commands and errors.

plugins.name: check
plugins.description: "Someone replied, what do I do now?" in one command. /check a GitHub issue/PR/comment, Slack or email link (or your clipboard) and Claude reads the whole thread and the code it touches, then gives where it stands, the next step and a reply ready to paste. It never posts or sends without your yes.

plugins.name: quick-replies
plugins.description: Answer Claude in one click. After each reply that asks, offers or hands you a step, pills above the prompt suggest what you'd most likely say next (Yes, No, Confirm, Check it for me, the options it listed), and clicking one sends it. Haiku picks them, only when there is something to answer.
